page.title: تماس با ما | CPMS
page.purpose: Two truthful routes only: (1) demo/consultation evaluation via /demo/; (2) general communication via the public contact details rendered from Koorosh Theme Settings. NOT a second lead form and NOT a support channel.

authoring.forms: none — the Demo form on /demo/ remains the only lead form

seo.schema: none — no Organization, no LocalBusiness, no invented address/phone

dynamicContactIntegration.why: Elementor keeps the editable page layout while the actual contact values stay global Koorosh Theme Settings rendered at runtime; changing a value needs no page rebuild and never edits Elementor copy.

publicContactRole.decision: Product Owner decision 2026-09-30: the currently authorized public/general contact email. Configuration evidence only; NOT a registered-company identity and NOT a support channel.
publicContactRole.rendering: always resolved (empty/invalid setting falls back to the authorized default); normal mailto: link; value escaped at output

leadRecipientRole.relationship: SEPARATE sales/demo delivery role. It may currently equal the public contact email, but the settings, defaults and resolvers are independent: changing one never silently changes the other.

optionalFields.contact_phone: row rendered ONLY when configured; tel: destination normalized to ASCII digits (Persian/Arabic digits converted, separators dropped, one leading + kept)
optionalFields.contact_address: row rendered ONLY when configured; plain text; no map integration
optionalFields.emptyOptionalFields: produce NO row, card or placeholder

dynamicContactIntegration.socialSettings: deliberately NOT rendered (no real URL configured; no icons or libraries)
dynamicContactIntegration.sanitization: every read passes through koorosh_get_setting() re-sanitization; every output fragment escaped (esc_html / esc_attr / esc_url); request data never read

unprovenOrUnverified.supportModel: UNVERIFIED / UNDEFINED — this page is not a support channel and claims no support, response time or SLA
unprovenOrUnverified.demoFormDelivery: NOT GUARANTEED — delivery is dual-gated and default OFF; the page copy makes no delivery or response-time promise
unprovenOrUnverified.phoneOrAddressPresence: NOT INVENTED — rendered only if an administrator configures them
